tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.description: Search Raise Lens for sustainability funding opportunities (grants and tenders) by topic, sector, country and deadline. Returns up to 10 matches, each with title, summary, sectors, geography, deadline, amount and a link to the opportunity page on raiselens.com.

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Fetch one Raise Lens grant or tender by its raiselens.com URL or id. Returns its title, summary, sectors, geography, deadline, amount, a link to the opportunity page and, where the opportunity page shows them, the funder, description, eligibility and key requirements.

tools.name: list_sectors
tools.description: List the sector slugs Raise Lens classifies opportunities against, each with a readable label. These slugs are the values the sector filters on this server accept.

tools.name: search_funders
tools.description: Search the Raise Lens directory of sustainability funders and investors (foundations, climate VCs, corporate investors, development finance institutions, government funders) by topic, funder type, funding type and geography. Returns up to 20 funders ranked by relevance to the query, then by how many

tools.name: search_opportunities_full
tools.description: Search Raise Lens grants and tenders and return full records: funder, description, eligibility, key requirements, source, apply link and the raiselens.com page. Up to 50 results a page; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page (first 1000 matches).

tools.name: get_opportunity_full
tools.description: Fetch one Raise Lens grant or tender by URL or id as a full record: funder, description, eligibility, key requirements, source, apply link and the raiselens.com page.

tools.name: list_new_opportunities
tools.description: Grants and tenders added to Raise Lens since a date (up to 90 days back), newest first, as full records (funder, description, eligibility, source, apply link). Optional filters: sector slug, country, type. Paged: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

tools.name: list_recent_raises
tools.description: Climate and sustainability companies that closed a funding round in the last N days (up to 90), newest first. Each raise has company, amount, currency, amount_usd, round, round_date, detected_date, sectors, countries, investors, source_url (the primary source; null when only a feed is known) and rai

tools.name: get_funder_full
tools.description: Fetch one Raise Lens funder by slug or raiselens.com/funders URL with full details: website and apply links, AUM or fund size, typical grant size, submission window, programmes and recent grants or investments, plus its name, type, sectors, geographic focus and cheque size.
